from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib
ROOT=Path.cwd()
R32="reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_source_and_prior_use_probe_v1"
R33="reports/research/510300_dr007_transaction_amount_history_acquisition_v1"
OUT=ROOT/R33
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"))
def save(n,x):
 p=OUT/n;assert not p.exists(),"已存在不覆盖"
 p.write_text(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
p=readj(R33+"/protocol.json")
for x in p["parents"]:assert sha(x["path"])==x["sha256"]
acq=readj(R33+"/acquisition_summary.json")
pre=readj(R33+"/现有运输可用性_无凭据.json")
assert acq["provider_requests"]==0 and acq["saved_rows"]==0 and pre["status"]=="NO_VALID_EXISTING_TRANSPORT_EXPIRED"
declared=pre.get("declared_proxy_expiry")
gate={"study_id":p["study_id"],"status":"NOT_ADMITTED_NO_VALID_EXISTING_TRANSPORT_NO_AMOUNT_HISTORY",
 "field_identity_known":True,"amount_history_rows_acquired":0,"provider_calls":0,
 "current_transport":"EXPIRED","declared_proxy_expiry":declared,"expired_transport_bypassed":False,
 "no_current_standard_transport_selected":True,
 "full_original_mature_training_support":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "full_original_decision_day_support":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "historical_first_publication_clock":"NOT_ESTABLISHED","historical_first_vintage":"NOT_ESTABLISHED",
 "model_admission":False,"missing_as_zero":False,"old_rate_contract_not_expanded":True,
 "candidate_economic_hypothesis_rejected":False,
 "scientific_interpretation":"字段真实但无可用历史金额序列，本轮未检验其收益增量；不是预测/机制失败。"}
save("source_gate.json",gate)
now=datetime.now(ZoneInfo("Asia/Shanghai")).isoformat()
status="STOPPED_HISTORY_ACQUISITION_EXISTING_TRANSPORT_EXPIRED_NO_PROVIDER_REQUESTS"
cls="PROGRESS_E32_DR007_AMOUNT_FIELD_CONFIRMED_E33_TRANSPORT_EXPIRY_IDENTIFIED_NO_MODEL_ADMISSION"
summary="E33登记同DR007/amount的原12年度分块采集，实际旧有效运输选择发现临时凭据已到期、无标准运输被选择，0提供方请求/0金额原行；未绕过到期、支付或改旧程序。字段的经济假设未被检验/否定，完整原训练支持、金额公开时钟和版本仍未知，源门未过。0新拟合/标签/账户/源码，夏普NOT_COMPUTED、完整目标未达。仅真正更新有效访问后可另留收件接续，现无活进程/会话，不自动轮询旧配置。"
result={"study_id":p["study_id"],"experiment_id":"E33","status":status,"completed_at":now,
 "classification":cls,"summary":summary,"source_gate":R33+"/source_gate.json",
 "facts_report":R33+"/成交额历史采集停止原因_研究结论.md",
 "provider_requests":0,"new_raw_source_objects":0,"new_download_bytes":0,"acquired_rows":0,
 "transport_status":pre["status"],"declared_proxy_expiry":declared,
 "new_fits":0,"new_training_labels":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,
 "net_sharpe":"NOT_COMPUTED","goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET",
 "orders_authorized":False,"new_prospective_forecasts_enabled":False,
 "candidate_hypothesis_rejected":False,"live_process_or_tool_session":False,"goal_status":"active",
 "current_goal_turn_is_progress":True,"consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":0,
 "transport_blocker_first_observed_goal_turn":"E32_E33_CURRENT_TURN",
 "transport_blocker_observed_consecutive_goal_turns":1,
 "root_impasse_proven":False,"user_missing_access_question_pending":True}
save("result.json",result)
report=f"""# E33：成交额历史采集停止，收益假设尚未检验

真实停止原因是项目现有临时数据访问已到期。按旧有效运输规则选择时，没有有效标准账户被选中；到期守卫在发请求前结束本轮。状态为{status}。提供方请求0、下载0、成交额历史原行0、模型拟合0、账户0、源码修改0。

E32已确认DR007.IB同一品种的amount字段和万元单位，官方也有同品种trdVol亿元字段；本轮没有否定经济假设。但没有完整金额序列，不能把旧weight利率改名成成交额、把缺失补0、缩减原成熟成员或把文档/单日例子当训练数据。公开时钟和历史首版仍NOT_ESTABLISHED，没有评分准入。

本轮登记的12年度分块方案原样保留，旧响应/运输代码/原模型未改。没有绕过到期、购买服务、切换失败地址或发订单；没有运行全仓测试。只有真正有效访问更新后，才能另存新的收件接续。本轮当前没有活进程或工具会话，聊天等待不算经过确认的作业等待，不反复重跑旧到期配置。

此前E32的字段/单位及旧日期空响应是实际新证据，本目标轮分类为进展，目标仍active，完整收益/夏普要求未达。该来源访问阻碍首次在本轮实证，尚未证明整个研究目标已无其他进展路径；不能第一次遇到就把目标标blocked。

当前已向用户提出缺失访问问题：若已有可用Tushare账户或项目代理访问，可在本地项目配置更新后回复；不在聊天发送密钥。未请求新增服务付费或交易授权。

证据：[固定采集协议](protocol.json)、[无凭据运输结果](现有运输可用性_无凭据.json)、[实际采集摘要](acquisition_summary.json)、[空请求账本](request_ledger.json)、[来源门](source_gate.json)、[完整结果](result.json)。
"""
(OUT/"成交额历史采集停止原因_研究结论.md").write_text(report,encoding="utf-8")
refs=[R32+"/protocol.json",R32+"/result.json",R32+"/source_gate.json",R33+"/protocol.json",R33+"/result.json",R33+"/source_gate.json"]
proposal={"experiment_id":"E34","proposed_study_id":"510300_DR007_TRANSACTION_AMOUNT_VALID_TRANSPORT_FOLLOWUP_V1",
 "proposed_at":now,"status":"PROPOSED_ONLY_AFTER_REAL_VALID_ACCESS_UPDATE_NOT_REGISTERED",
 "question":"只有现有本地访问真实更新且按原到期守卫选择为有效后，另注册同代码/字段/12分块的首次实际收件接续。保留E33到期停止原件，不重复旧过期配置/支付新服务。成功取得完整金额再核所有原成员/决定日、旧weight版本和公布时钟，门通过后另注册一次原参数联合评分；未取得就保持未检验，不把名义日期/0量当数据。",
 "required_external_change":"当前项目有真实有效标准Tushare或既有项目代理访问；不是等待日期或认为工具仍运行。",
 "same_source_identity":"repo_daily / DR007.IB / DR007 / amount万元",
 "same_request_plan":p["chunks"],"same_budget":p["budget"],
 "original_stopped_attempt_preserved":True,"registered":False,"provider_requests":0,"new_fits":0,"new_full_accounts":0,"source_code_edits":0,
 "references":[{"path":x,"sha256":sha(x)} for x in refs],
 "goal_achieved":False,"current_view":"NO_VIEW","position":"UNSET"}
save("next_experiment.json",proposal)
save("本轮目标接续归属.json",{"previous_goal_turn_steps":["E31"],"current_goal_turn_steps":["E32","E33"],
 "current_goal_turn_classification":cls,"consecutive_blocked_goal_turns":0,
 "new_evidence_changes_next_action":"真实amount字段确定；官方旧日期空响应不作数据；现有到期访问不能采集，下一只依真实有效访问更新。",
 "specific_transport_blocker_first_seen_this_goal_turn":True,"specific_transport_blocker_observed_goal_turns":1,
 "root_goal_impasse_proven":False,"goal_status":"active","goal_achieved":False})
save("必要核对.json",{"all_8_frozen_parents_unchanged":True,"current_transport_expiry_observed":True,
 "provider_requests_equal_0":True,"amount_history_rows_equal_0":True,
 "no_expiry_bypass_no_new_payment_no_code_edits":True,"hypothesis_not_tested_not_rejected":True,
 "no_live_job_or_session":True,"new_fits":0,"new_accounts":0,"goal_achieved":False})
print(json.dumps({"实验":"E33真实停止原因已保存","有效访问":"临时访问到期","请求":0,"金额历史原行":0,"模型":0,"目标":"active，未达"},ensure_ascii=False))
kind: E33实际到期守卫停止及源门裁决
